AI setup

Connect your OpenAI API key to personalize a resume and critically review it against a saved job.

Checking the local OpenAI server…

The key stays in the local server’s memory until it restarts. It is never saved in your browser, resume, or exports.

Personalization sends your current resume and selected job description to OpenAI in two API calls: draft, then critical review and revision. Review the proposal before applying it. This uses your OpenAI API credits.
